The pair identity uses the actual index-zero inverse spectator reindexing and pairKSLift=pairCoordinates(KS(y),spectator). They follow by composing the configuration equalities. Any particular normalized-origin-difference function can be substituted as g, but these modules themselves do not prove its analytic estimates or Taylor-coefficient invariance.
